source.title: Automotive Power Battery Charging and Discharging Test Solution Market to Reach USD 1.07 Billion by 2034 as EV Battery Testing Demand Increases
source.body:
Global Automotive Power Battery Charging and Discharging Test Solution Market was valued at USD 647.00 million in 2025 and is estimated to reach USD 684.21 million in 2026. According to Energy Resources Insights, the market is projected to reach USD 1,070.25 million by 2034, representing a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 5.8% during 2026–2034. Increasing electric vehicle development, battery performance requirements and the need for reliable charging and discharging evaluation are supporting demand for advanced automotive battery testing equipment.

https://www.energyresourcesinsights.com/automotive-power-battery-charging-and-discharging-test-solution-market-114

Automotive power battery charging and discharging test solutions are specialized systems used to evaluate battery charging behaviour, discharge performance, capacity, efficiency and operating characteristics. These systems support battery manufacturers, automotive OEMs and research laboratories during product development, quality verification and production testing. The market includes EV and HEV testing equipment, with solutions designed for individual cells, battery modules and complete battery packs.

Market at a Glance

2025 market size: USD 647.00 million
2026 estimate: USD 684.21 million
2034 forecast: USD 1,070.25 million
Forecast CAGR: 5.8% during 2026–2034
Leading region: Asia-Pacific, with an estimated 49% of 2025 revenue
Leading test type: EV Test, with an estimated 64% of 2025 revenue
Leading application: New Energy Vehicles, accounting for approximately 79% of 2025 revenue

EV Battery Development and Advanced Testing Equipment Support Growth

The growing electric vehicle industry is increasing the need for advanced battery testing equipment. Charging and discharging systems help manufacturers evaluate battery capacity, energy efficiency, current capability and performance under different operating conditions. These tests are important for product development, battery qualification and quality control.

High-voltage battery systems require equipment capable of handling demanding electrical conditions. For example, Keysight describes battery pack testing solutions supporting voltages up to 1,500 V and output power up to 300 kW. Chroma's 17040 regenerative battery test systems cover power ratings of 60–300 kW and voltage ranges of 60–1,000 V.

Regenerative testing equipment offers another advantage by returning discharge energy to the facility rather than dissipating all of it as heat. This capability can help laboratories manage energy consumption during repeated testing operations.

Key Market Drivers and Challenges

Several factors are shaping the industry's outlook:

Electric vehicle manufacturing: Expanding EV production increases demand for battery pack testing and charging evaluation equipment.
Battery performance optimization: Manufacturers require accurate systems to evaluate energy capacity, efficiency and discharge characteristics.
High-voltage battery development: Advanced electric vehicle architectures increase the need for high-voltage and high-power testing solutions.
Hybrid vehicle testing: HEV development creates demand for systems that evaluate regenerative braking and rapid charge acceptance.
Regenerative testing technology: Energy recovery capabilities can improve testing facility efficiency.

The market also faces challenges. High-power testing systems involve substantial capital investment, specialized electrical infrastructure and stringent safety requirements. Equipment buyers must evaluate voltage ranges, power ratings, measurement accuracy and software compatibility. Maintenance, technical support and operator training also influence procurement decisions.

Segmentation and Regional Outlook

The market is segmented by type, application, product form and functional category.

Type: EV Test; HEV Test.
Application: New Energy Vehicles; Two-wheeled and Three-wheeled Vehicles.
Product form: Single Cell Testing; Battery Module Testing; Battery Pack Testing.
Functional category: Performance Testing; Safety Testing; Lifespan Testing.

Asia-Pacific led the market with an estimated 49% share of 2025 revenue, followed by Europe at approximately 23%. The region benefits from extensive electric vehicle manufacturing, battery production and automotive testing infrastructure.

Europe represents an important market through its established automotive engineering industry and battery development activities. North America also contributes through EV technology development, battery manufacturing investment and demand for advanced testing systems. South America and the Middle East & Africa present longer-term opportunities as electric mobility infrastructure expands.

Competitive Landscape

The competitive environment includes manufacturers of battery cyclers, regenerative testing systems, high-voltage testing equipment and specialized laboratory solutions.

Key companies covered in the report include Chroma ATE, Arbin Instruments, Bitrode, Keysight Technologies, Digatron, ESPEC, Fujian Nebula Electronics, Kikusui Electronics, AVL and Maccor.

These companies compete through equipment power ratings, voltage capabilities, measurement accuracy, software functionality and technical support. Their solutions address different testing requirements across cells, modules and complete automotive battery packs.
